children.title: Axe
children.description: accessibility engine designed to work on all modern browsers and with whatever tools, frameworks, libraries, and environments you use today. It's an automated accessibility testing tool for developers.

children.title: ANDI
children.description: accessibility testing tool for web content (bookmarklet). It will automatically detect accessibility issues, give suggestions to improve online accessibility and check 508 compliance.

children.title: Accessible Palette Builder
children.description: an Elm-based prototype to help designers build accessible color palettes.

children.title: A11ygator
children.description: a web tool to analyze websites against WCAG rules. Also available as Google Chrome browser extension and as Twitter bot.

items.description:
Accessibility is the practice of creating websites and apps usable for all people, including individuals with visual, motor, auditory, speech, or cognitive disabilities. Here you will find web accessibility tools, accessibility testing tools, and accessibility apps both for developers and designers:
Accessibility checking features are also available in VisBug from the Visual Debugging Tools category.
items.title: Accessibility Tools

children.title: React Color
children.description: a collection of color pickers from Sketch, Photoshop, Chrome. It‘s free and open-source.

children.title: Material Colors Native
children.description: Google's material design color palette in the form of a mac app.

children.title: Color Deck
children.description: an HSL driven color palette collection. It's also open-source.

items.description:
If you are looking for an eyedropper tool, color identifier or color capture, check this section. With the color pickers mentioned here, you will be able to create new color combinations and define great ones. Almost all of these tools are free:
You can also create color palettes with Leonardo, which is mentioned in the Accessibility Tools section.
items.title: Color Picker Tools

children.title: Google Webfonts Helper
children.description: a hassle way to self-host Google Fonts. It‘s free and open-source.

children.title: Web Font Preview
children.description: preview Google Font pairings with components and site templates.

items.description:
Fonts are commonly used for making the web a more beautiful place. It’s an essential part of any design. In this section, you’ll find fonts generators & font finder tools that allow you to manage and work with fonts:
You can also handle fonts with Specify, which is mentioned in the Design System Tools section.
items.title: Font Tools

children.title: Font Awesome
children.description: the web's most popular icon set and toolkit, also it's open source.

children.title: Fontello
children.description: tool to build custom fonts with icons, also open source.

items.description:
As well as fonts, icons are used in every design. These basic elements support and guide many user actions inside the product. Without a doubt, icons are a vital element in user navigation. While making those small design elements is hard and time-consuming, you can get thousands of vector icons for personal and commercial use.
You can also handle icons with Specify, which is mentioned in the Design System Tools section.
items.title: Icons Tools

children.title: Data Pixels
children.description: create pixel art programmatically. Includes DataPixels.js and Data Pixels Playground desktop app.

items.description: Pixel art is a digital art form where color is applied to individual pixels to create an image. The pixel art can be used to create everything from intricate scenes and game backgrounds to character designs or emoji. If you feel curious to try, check this pixel art software for both macOS and Windows:
items.title: Pixel Art Tools

children.title: Kap
children.description: open source screen recorder with options to export to GIF, MP4, WebM and APNG.

children.title: ScreenToGif
children.description: record a gif of part of the screen. Only available for Windows.

items.description: Taking screenshots is a typical task in the design & development workflow. So these free and full-featured screenshot apps can help you capture a screen with ease. Some screen captures are macOS only, while others support both OS:
items.title: Screenshot Software
